item.title: The Saturday Signal: Hormuz, APS Ruling, Permitting Bill
item.description: Oil posts its first weekly gain of November as Hormuz attacks continue, and OPEC+ meets amid a quota fight. The judge's recommendation lands in the APS rate case ahead of a December 17 vote, the Senate-passed permitting bill heads to the House, and we look at Lightning sales, sodium-ion costs and Europe's record-low gas storage. Script: https://docs.google.com/document/d/1e81-Uw3wNB1VJ7oWmZXkZ2jC3l5ik8cyV54iea7UuxQ/edit

item.title: The AI Crossover: Isomorphic's $5B, Device Proof, Bank AI Guardrails
item.description: Isomorphic Labs raises $5 billion and signs with MSD before any human trials; FDA clears practical imaging AI while CMS and ECRI push for real-world outcome evidence; banks and insurers put AI agents on a leash. Plus a hype check on claims that AI-discovered drugs succeed more often in trials. Script: https://docs.google.com/document/d/1vDl3xt-T5TUSvO4EGG5BSfNq_EJP79at96e0hIjeMAo/edit
